args.query:
CREATE TABLE cohort_summary AS 
SELECT cohort_id, 
       COUNT(*) AS cohort_size, 
       (SELECT contact_note 
        FROM participants 
        WHERE cohort_id = c.cohort_id 
        LIMIT 1) AS representative_comment 
FROM participants c 
GROUP BY cohort_id;

args.query:
CREATE TABLE cohort_summary AS 
SELECT cohort, 
       COUNT(*) AS cohort_size, 
       (SELECT contact_notes 
        FROM participants 
        WHERE cohort = p.cohort 
        LIMIT 1) AS representative_comment 
FROM participants p 
GROUP BY cohort;

args.query:
UPDATE cohort_summary SET representative_comment = 
(SELECT contact_notes 
 FROM participants 
 WHERE cohort = cohort_summary.cohort 
 AND contact_notes IS NOT NULL 
 LIMIT 1) 
WHERE representative_comment IS NULL;
